Target Material.cell: phyllosilicate (matrix); oxide (magnetite, ilmenite); sulfide (pyrrhotite, pentlandite); carbonate (dolomite, magnesite); phosphate (Ca phosphate, Na-Mg hydrous phosphate) — phases analysed and mapped by EPMA (results)

Sample Preparation Method.cell: Fragments mounted and dry-polished in a petrographic thin section; carbon coating N
Sample Preparation Method.value: Fragments mounted and dry-polished in a petrographic thin section; carbon coating N

Sampling Unit Type.cell: Region of interest > Phase — "wavelength-dispersive quantitative compositional mapping and analysis" (p.3) of whole fragments; phases are identified within a map ("Round Phy1 phyllosilicate clast", "Lithic clast (LC1)", Fig. 3, p.6) and abundances given per section ("sulfides which make up 2.3 areal% of the section", p.6)

Sampling Unit Selection Criteria.cell: N — the paper names the phases it analysed (see `Sampling Unit Type`) but states no rule for choosing the individual units

Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening.cell: Optical microscopy of the same thin section — "Eleven OC002 LAB24-2 fragments were mounted and dry-polished in a petrographic thin section used for optical microscopy and electron probe microanalyses" (p.3)
Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening.value: Optical microscopy of the same thin section

Data Processing Software(s).cell: Probe for EPMA (CITZAF matrix correction, Armstrong 1995); CalcImage and Quantitative Microanalysis Explorer web-based tool (for stage mapping)

Analytical Mode.cell: WDS Point Analysis; WDS Mapping — 'wavelength-dispersive quantitative compositional mapping and analysis'

Beam Current.cell: all: 25 nA — '15 kV accelerating potential and 25 nA probe current for point analysis'

Target Species.cell: F, O, CO2, H2O — F measured; 'Oxygen was calculated by elemental stoichiometry with water estimated by inspection of the analytical total, and for carbonates, CO2 was calculated by stoichiometry'; the other analysed elements are not named

Monitored Elements.key: defines: monitored property per target species
Monitored Elements.cell: F — 'Fluorine measurement was made using the LDE1 diffracting crystal'; no other element is named

Reported Variables and Units.cell: Element concentrations in the carbonates (wt%: Fe, Mn — "Dolomite contains 2.0 ± 0.4 wt% Fe and 3.0 ± 0.9 wt% Mn (n = 37)", p.5); phase abundance as areal fraction of the section (areal%, e.g. sulfides "2.3 areal%", p.6); phase identifications from the X-ray maps (nominal)

value.member: phase abundance as areal fraction of the section
phase identifications from the X-ray maps

X-ray Detection Method per Monitored Ele.cell: all: WDS — 'wavelength-dispersive quantitative compositional mapping and analysis'

X-ray Background Correction Method.cell: F: polynomial fit to the background determined on representative phases; other: Mean Atomic Number (MAN) — 'the mean atomic number (MAN) background calibration was made using these standards'

value.value: polynomial fit to the background determined on representative phases

Target Species Estimation Method.cell: O, CO2: Stoichiometry from cations; H2O: estimated by inspection of the analytical total; F: Direct (measured) — p.3

value.value: estimated by inspection of the analytical total

Analysis Inclusion and Rejection Criteri.cell: Partially — the carbonate compositions are means of stated counts ("Dolomite contains 2.0 ± 0.4 wt% Fe and 3.0 ± 0.9 wt% Mn (n = 37)"; "Magnesite contains 14.5 ± 2.7 wt% Fe and 4.6 ± 2.5 wt % Mn (n = 23)", p.5). No acceptance or rejection rule is stated

Combination Method.cell: Element concentrations in the carbonates: mean per carbonate phase; other: N — dolomite n = 37, magnesite n = 23 (p.5)

Primary Calibration Standard Name.cell: all [F: synthetic F-phlogopite; other: N] — 'natural and synthetic minerals routinely used in the analytical facility'

Secondary Reference Materials.cell: Smithsonian Microbeam standards (specific materials and values N)

Counting Statistics Error.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property

Additional Notes.cell: Broussard et al. 2026, Meteorit. Planet. Sci. — OC002 CI chondrite links Bennu and Ryugu. Washington University in St. Louis. Instrument stated as "JEOL JXA-8200 electron microprobe" — NOT JXA-8230 as in v2 header. WDS explicitly stated ("wavelength-dispersive quantitative compositional mapping and analysis"). CITZAF matrix correction (Armstrong 1995) — NOT PAP or XPP. MAN background for most analytes; polynomial fit for F via LDE1 crystal. Both point analysis (15 kV, 25 nA) and quantitative stage mapping performed. O by stoichiometry from cations. F is the only explicitly named analyte in methods; full list N. An EDS spectrometer is on the instrument; its use is not stated. Smithsonian Microbeam standards as secondary QC. No peak counting time, beam diameter, detection limits, or interference corrections stated.
